findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: update_board, check_board_layout · Private data: submit_feedback, get_board, export_board, claim_guest_board · Public sink: submit_feedback · Destructive: create_board, update_board, delete_board.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: update_board, check_board_layout · Private data: submit_feedback, get_board, export_board, claim_guest_board · Public sink: submit_feedback · Destructive: create_board, update_board, delete_board

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
